digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM substrate and provider routing
propositions: Bedrock provider parity must be measured before it becomes a first-class provider, using a harness modeled on fidelity_spot_eval with the same parity bar, epoch-majority aggregation, and committed-results-plus-offline-recheck shape.

The parity harness must prove payload equivalence, tool set equivalence, provider-clean routing, and explicit capability differences across both standard (claude-sonnet-4-6) and frontier (claude-opus-4-8) model slots, with provider as the only variable between arms.

Both Bedrock inference-profile ids must be invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 with a pre-corpus Step 1 probe for each candidate id, both bare and with temperature=0, before any corpus spend occurs.

The corpus pools gold-labeled cases across eval specs using a deterministic stratified sample of 30 items (15 gold-block, 15 gold-advisory) excluding agentic disposable-store arms, run at N=3 epochs per arm per slot with epoch-majority reduction and error classification.

The recorded ParityReport artifact must carry either a measured block with pass/fail verdict and full metrics or an unmeasured block with a refusal string for each class slot; offline re-scoring without model calls must confirm consistency with the parity bar.
The v2 arm must be proven provider-clean via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally showing zero non-Bedrock calls across all measured case-runs on both slots.
